packages.name: @humanfs/node
packages.mitigation: The package is absent from the production API artifact and is executed only by the repository lint toolchain.
packages.revisit: Recheck the classification when ESLint changes its filesystem implementation or the production artifact boundary changes.

packages.name: baseline-browser-mapping
packages.mitigation: Next 16.3.4 resolves baseline-browser-mapping 2.11.0 or newer through its supported dependency graph without a repository override.
packages.revisit: Recheck the browser target graph when Next changes its baseline-browser-mapping dependency or the Web build target policy changes.

packages.name: multer
packages.mitigation: The supported NestJS 11 parent @nestjs/platform-express declares Multer 2.2.0 directly, so the safe runtime line resolves naturally without a root override and the unused upload surface remains unchanged.
packages.revisit: Recheck parent ownership and upload behavior whenever @nestjs/platform-express changes its Multer dependency or the application adopts a direct upload caller.

packages.name: mysql2
packages.mitigation: The driver remains in the shipped Prisma CLI graph, while application database calls use PostgreSQL through pg and @prisma/adapter-pg.
packages.revisit: Remove the parent-scoped selector when Prisma declares mysql2 3.23.1 or newer, or when a verified production deploy excludes the Prisma CLI graph.

packages.name: next
packages.mitigation: The Web runtime moves to the supported Next 16.3.4 patch and verifies the standalone build plus browser surfaces rather than suppressing either critical advisory.
packages.revisit: Recheck Next security advisories on every supported-line migration and before a production release.

packages.name: postcss
packages.mitigation: The root override keeps PostCSS 8.5.28 while current build parents still include older exact patches.
packages.revisit: Remove the override when Next, Tailwind, Sentry, Storybook, and Vite all resolve PostCSS 8.5.28 or newer without it and their closest build regressions pass.

packages.name: qs
packages.mitigation: The compatible patched release is resolved through the existing Express and body-parser ranges without changing the public HTTP contract.
packages.revisit: Recheck legitimate query and form parsing behavior whenever the Express HTTP adapter or parser configuration changes.

packages.name: sharp
packages.mitigation: Next 16.3.4 naturally resolves Sharp 0.35.4 and the Web standalone artifact plus next/image callers are verified without a root override.
packages.revisit: Recheck the image optimizer graph when Next or the production image handling policy changes.

packages.name: ws
packages.mitigation: Parent-scoped overrides keep the Engine.IO and Socket.IO adapter paths on ws 8.21.3 while their declared ranges stop at the 8.20 line.
packages.revisit: Remove each selector when engine.io and socket.io-adapter widen or update their ws dependency and realtime plus Storybook regressions pass.
